content.text: bash sandbox requested but unavailable on this host; refusing to run unconfined. Bubblewrap is installed but cannot create a namespace here, which is typical inside a default container or on a kernel that restricts unprivileged user namespaces. Run the container with the privileges bubblewrap needs (typically CAP_SYS_ADMIN together with an unconfined seccomp profile; either widens the container itself), or set [sandbox] bash = "off" in config.toml / Settings -> Sandbox; shell commands then run unconfined and the container or host is the only boundary.
